spec.notes: Every node is one of the catalog's types with equal odds (networking types too), then one of that type's images with equal odds; the SIEM (Wazuh manager) is left out: each one downloads and unpacks Wazuh's CVE feed (~2-3 GB of disk), which made Docker's disk, not memory, the limit; switches and routers draw from their own pools (routers must forward, so no default-drop firewalls there).
